_meta.purpose: A SHARED (de-identified) gene↔drug reference base for pharmacogenetics. Does NOT contain the data of a particular patient — the genotype is taken from profile/pharmacogenomics.json at the moment of the request. Freely shareable.
_meta.source: Derived from CPIC (api.cpicpgx.org, CC0), fetched 2026-08-19. Three layers, each labelled: (1) the PHENOTYPE models — allele functional status, activity-score→phenotype bands, NUDT15 function combinations — are verbatim from the CPIC tables; (2) each guidance entry that carries a `cpic` block quotes CPIC's OWN recommendation and implication wording verbatim, with its strength of recommendation; (3) the `note` beside it is this project's plain-language line for the patient, in their language — a paraphrase, and never presented as the guideline's words. Pairs without a `cpic` block have no verbatim text yet (warfarin needs the dosing algorithm, amitriptyline the joint CYP2D6+CYP2C19 table); their level and note remain project-compiled. `scholion sources --refresh --only cpic` re-checks all of this against the live source. Genotypes are never here; they come from profile/pharmacogenomics.json at request time.

levels.high: a substantial genetic factor — must be discussed with the doctor before prescribing
levels.moderate: a noticeable factor — worth mentioning to the doctor
levels.low: no features by the available markers / the standard approach
levels.unknown: the gene required is not covered by the patient's data (an additional test is needed, e.g. WGS)

_meta.source_tier_note: The phenotype models and the quoted recommendations are verbatim; the patient-facing notes, the severity levels, and the pairs still without a quote are compiled. One tier word would be a claim about the whole file that is false of part of it.
_meta.emits_contract: Every gene declares `emits`: the phenotype vocabulary its model can produce. A drug's guidance table must be keyed in the vocabulary of ITS gene — a gate enforces the correspondence. Without it, changing a model's vocabulary (DPYD moved from deficient/intermediate/normal to NM/IM/PM when it became activity-score) silently orphans every row of the table keyed in the old one, and the answer falls through to the gap branch while nothing fails.

not_a_cpic_drug_pair.en: CPIC publishes no methotrexate/MTHFR (or any MTHFR drug) guideline, and ACMG recommends AGAINST clinical testing of MTHFR C677T/A1298C. MTHFR is kept for folate/longevity context only, not as a pharmacogenetic dosing signal.

CYP2C9.activity_source: Allele activity values and score→phenotype bands taken verbatim from CPIC (api.cpicpgx.org/v1/allele and /v1/diplotype, fetched 2026-08-19; CPIC content is CC0). Replaces the earlier count-by-function rules, which read CYP2C9 *2/*3 as intermediate; the activity score 0.5 is a poor metaboliser.
CYP2C9._phenotype_rules_retired: superseded by the activity_score model above; kept out of the computation. The count model could not express an activity score.

DPYD.activity_source: Allele activity values and score→phenotype bands taken verbatim from CPIC (api.cpicpgx.org/v1/allele and /v1/diplotype, fetched 2026-08-19; CPIC content is CC0). Replaces the earlier count-by-function rules, which read CYP2C9 *2/*3 as intermediate; the activity score 0.5 is a poor metaboliser.

NUDT15.source: CPIC NUDT15 allele functionality (api.cpicpgx.org, CC0, 2026-08-19): *3 (rs116855232, c.415C>T) no function. Function-combination phenotype, not activity score.

why.en: CYP2C19 activates clopidogrel into the active metabolite; decreased function → decreased activation.
why.ru: CYP2C19 активирует клопидогрел в активный метаболит; сниженная функция → сниженная активация.

note.en: A poor metaboliser → the active metabolite is formed poorly, the antiplatelet effect may be insufficient. Discuss an alternative with the doctor (prasugrel/ticagrelor).
note.ru: Медленный метаболизатор → активный метаболит образуется плохо, антиагрегантный эффект может быть недостаточным. Обсудить с врачом альтернативу (прасугрел/тикагрелор).

cpic.recommendation: Avoid clopidogrel if possible. Use prasugrel or ticagrelor at standard dose if no contraindication.
cpic.implication: Significantly reduced clopidogrel active metabolite formation; increased on-treatment platelet reactivity; increased risk for adverse cardiac and cerebrovascular events

note.en: There is a loss-of-function allele → activation may be reduced, a risk of an insufficient effect. Discuss with the doctor an alternative or a platelet function test.
note.ru: Есть аллель потери функции → активация может быть снижена, риск недостаточного эффекта. Обсудить с врачом альтернативу или тест функции тромбоцитов.

cpic.recommendation: Avoid standard dose (75 mg) clopidogrel if possible. Use prasugrel or ticagrelor at standard dose if no contraindication.
cpic.implication: Reduced clopidogrel active metabolite formation; increased on-treatment platelet reactivity; increased risk for adverse cardiac and cerebrovascular events

note.en: The standard approach for this gene.
note.ru: Стандартный подход по этому гену.

cpic.recommendation: If considering clopidogrel, use at standard dose (75 mg/day)
cpic.implication: Normal or increased clopidogrel active metabolite formation; normal or lower on-treatment platelet reactivity; no association with higher bleeding risk

note.en: The standard approach for this gene.
note.ru: Стандартный подход по этому гену.

cpic.recommendation: If considering clopidogrel, use at standard dose (75 mg/day)
cpic.implication: Increased clopidogrel active metabolite formation; lower on-treatment platelet reactivity; no association with higher bleeding risk

note.en: The standard approach for this gene.
note.ru: Стандартный подход по этому гену.

cpic.recommendation: If considering clopidogrel, use at standard dose (75 mg/day)
cpic.implication: Normal clopidogrel active metabolite formation; normal on-treatment platelet reactivity

note.en: Clarify the CYP2C19 status; if the function is decreased, discuss it with the doctor.
note.ru: Уточнить CYP2C19-статус; при снижении функции обсудить с врачом.

why.en: CYP2C19 metabolises PPIs; the function of the gene affects exposure and efficacy.
why.ru: CYP2C19 метаболизирует ИПП; функция гена влияет на экспозицию и эффективность.

note.en: Accelerated metabolism → exposure and efficacy may be reduced; if the response is insufficient, discuss the dose/the choice with the doctor.
note.ru: Ускоренный метаболизм → возможна сниженная экспозиция и эффективность; при недостаточном ответе обсудить с врачом дозу/выбор.

cpic.recommendation: Increase starting daily dose by 100%. Daily dose may be given in divided doses. Monitor for efficacy.
cpic.implication: Decreased plasma concentrations of PPIs compared to CYP2C19 NMs; increased risk of therapeutic failure

note.en: Exposure may be reduced; take this into account if the response is insufficient.
note.ru: Возможна сниженная экспозиция; учитывать при недостаточном ответе.

cpic.recommendation:
Initiate standard starting daily dose. Consider increasing dose by 50-100% for the treatment of H. pylori infection and erosive esophagitis. Daily dose may be given in divided doses.
Monitor for efficacy.
cpic.implication: Decreased plasma concentrations of PPIs compared to CYP2C19 NMs; increased risk of therapeutic failure

note.en: Increased exposure — usually favourable for efficacy; in some cases a lower dose can be discussed.
note.ru: Повышенная экспозиция — обычно благоприятно для эффективности; в ряде случаев можно обсудить меньшую дозу.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate standard starting daily dose. For chronic therapy (>12 weeks) and efficacy achieved, consider 50% reduction in daily dose and monitor for continued efficacy.
cpic.implication: Increased plasma concentration of PPI compared to CYP2C19 NMs; increased chance of efficacy and potentially toxicity

note.en: The standard approach.
note.ru: Стандартный подход.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate standard starting daily dose. For chronic therapy (>12 weeks) and efficacy achieved, consider 50% reduction in daily dose and monitor for continued efficacy.
cpic.implication: Increased plasma concentration of PPI compared to CYP2C19 NMs; increased chance of efficacy and potentially toxicity

note.en: The standard approach.
note.ru: Стандартный подход.

cpic.recommendation:
Initiate standard starting daily dose. Consider increasing dose by 50-100% for the treatment of H. pylori infection and erosive esophagitis. Daily dose may be given in divided doses.
Monitor for efficacy.
cpic.implication: Normal PPI metabolism; may be at increased risk of therapeutic failure compared to CYP2C19 IMs and PMs

note.en: No substantial features have been found by the markers.
note.ru: Существенных особенностей по маркерам не выявлено.

why.en: CYP2C19 metabolises citalopram/escitalopram/sertraline; it affects exposure.
why.ru: CYP2C19 метаболизирует циталопрам/эсциталопрам/сертралин; влияет на экспозицию.

note.en: Normal CYP2C19 metabolism — the recommended starting dose applies.
note.ru: Нормальный метаболизм CYP2C19 — действует рекомендованная стартовая доза.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with recommended starting dose
cpic.implication: Normal metabolism

note.en: Reduced metabolism — the concentration is higher, so side effects are likelier; the starting dose is unchanged but titration should be slower. Discuss with the doctor.
note.ru: Сниженный метаболизм — концентрация выше, побочные вероятнее; стартовая доза та же, но наращивать медленнее. Обсудите с врачом.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with recommended starting dose. Consider a slower titration schedule and lower maintenance dose than normal metabolizers.
cpic.implication: Reduced metabolism when compared to CYP2C19 normal metabolizers. Higher plasma concentrations may increase the probability of side effects.

note.en: Accelerated metabolism → the concentration may be reduced; if the response is insufficient, discuss the dose/an alternative.
note.ru: Ускоренный метаболизм → возможна сниженная концентрация; при недостаточном ответе обсудить дозу/альтернативу.

cpic.recommendation: Consider a clinically appropriate alternative antidepressant not predominantly metabolized by CYP2C19. If citalopram or escitalopram are clinically appropriate, and adequate efficacy is not achieved at standard maintenance dosing, consider titrating to a higher maintenance dose.
cpic.implication: Increased metabolism of citalopram and escitalopram to less active compounds when compared to CYP2C19 rapid and normal metabolizers. Lower plasma concentrations decrease the probability of clinical benefit.

note.en: The concentration may be reduced.
note.ru: Возможна сниженная концентрация.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with recommended starting dose. If patient does not adequately respond to recommended maintenance dosing, consider titrating to a higher maintenance dose or switching to a clinically appropriate alternative antidepressant not predominantly metabolized by CYP2C19.
cpic.implication: Increase in metabolism of citalopram and escitalopram to less active compounds when compared to CYP2C19 normal metabolizers. Lower plasma concentrations decrease the probability of clinical benefit.

note.en: Increased concentration → CPIC recommends considering a reduced dose of citalopram/escitalopram.
note.ru: Повышенная концентрация → CPIC рекомендует рассмотреть сниженную дозу циталопрама/эсциталопрама.

cpic.recommendation: Consider a clinically appropriate antidepressant not predominantly metabolized by CYP2C19. If citalopram or escitalopram are clinically appropriate, consider a lower starting dose, slower titration schedule and 50% reduction of the standard maintenance dose as compared to normal metabolizers.
cpic.implication: Reduced metabolism of citalopram and escitalopram to less active compounds when compared to CYP2C19 normal and intermediate metabolizers. Higher plasma concentrations may increase the probability of side effects.

note.en: No substantial features have been found by the markers.
note.ru: Существенных особенностей по маркерам не выявлено.

why.en: CYP2C19 (and CYP2D6) metabolise tricyclics; they affect the drug/metabolite ratio.
why.ru: CYP2C19 (и CYP2D6) метаболизируют трициклики; влияют на соотношение препарат/метаболит.

note.en: Normal CYP2C19 metabolism — the usual starting dose applies. A full assessment also needs CYP2D6.
note.ru: Нормальный метаболизм CYP2C19 — действует обычная стартовая доза. Для полной оценки нужен также CYP2D6.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with recommended starting dose.
cpic.implication: Normal metabolism of tertiary amines
cpic.assumes: CPIC's amitriptyline table is keyed on CYP2D6 AND CYP2C19 together. The quote below is the row for a NORMAL CYP2D6; if CYP2D6 is not normal the row differs, which is why CYP2D6 is named as a co-gene and why an unresolved CYP2D6 is said so rather than assumed away.

note.en: Intermediate CYP2C19 metabolism — with a normal CYP2D6 the starting dose is unchanged. A full assessment also needs CYP2D6.
note.ru: Промежуточный метаболизм CYP2C19 — при нормальном CYP2D6 стартовая доза не меняется. Для полной оценки нужен также CYP2D6.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with recommended starting dose.
cpic.implication: Reduced metabolism of tertiary amines compared to normal metabolizers
cpic.assumes: CPIC's amitriptyline table is keyed on CYP2D6 AND CYP2C19 together. The quote below is the row for a NORMAL CYP2D6; if CYP2D6 is not normal the row differs, which is why CYP2D6 is named as a co-gene and why an unresolved CYP2D6 is said so rather than assumed away.

note.en: Poor CYP2C19 metabolism — concentrations rise and CPIC advises avoiding amitriptyline; if it is used, a halved starting dose and drug-level monitoring. Discuss with the doctor.
note.ru: Медленный метаболизм CYP2C19 — концентрация растёт, CPIC советует избегать амитриптилина; если он назначен — половинная стартовая доза и контроль концентрации. Обсудите с врачом.

cpic.recommendation: Avoid amitriptyline use. If amitripyline is warranted, consider a 50% reduction of recommended starting dose. Utilize therapeutic drug monitoring to guide dose adjustments.
cpic.implication: Greatly reduced metabolism of tertiary amines compared to normal metabolizers; Decreased conversion of tertiary amines to secondary amines may affect response or side effects
cpic.assumes: CPIC's amitriptyline table is keyed on CYP2D6 AND CYP2C19 together. The quote below is the row for a NORMAL CYP2D6; if CYP2D6 is not normal the row differs, which is why CYP2D6 is named as a co-gene and why an unresolved CYP2D6 is said so rather than assumed away.

note.en: A full assessment of TCAs also requires CYP2D6 (the full diplotype, WGS). Discuss it with the doctor.
note.ru: Для полной оценки ТЦА нужен также CYP2D6 (полный диплотип, WGS). Обсудить с врачом.

guidance_gap_reason.en: CPIC's row for a CYP2C19 rapid metaboliser has not been imported verbatim yet — writing one from memory is what this work exists to stop.
guidance_gap_reason.ru: Строка CPIC для быстрого метаболизатора CYP2C19 ещё не импортирована дословно — писать её по памяти как раз то, что эта работа призвана прекратить.

guidance_gap_reason.en: CPIC's row for a CYP2C19 ultrarapid metaboliser has not been imported verbatim yet.
guidance_gap_reason.ru: Строка CPIC для сверхбыстрого метаболизатора CYP2C19 ещё не импортирована дословно.

why.en: CYP2C19 is the main metabolic pathway of voriconazole.

note.en: Normal voriconazole metabolism — standard of care dosing applies.
note.ru: Нормальный метаболизм вориконазола — действует стандартное дозирование.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with recommended standard of care dosing
cpic.implication: Normal voriconazole metabolism

note.en: Higher trough concentrations than a normal metaboliser — standard dosing still applies, and drug-level monitoring is worth discussing.
note.ru: Более высокие остаточные концентрации, чем у нормального метаболизатора — стандартное дозирование сохраняется, контроль концентрации стоит обсудить.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with recommended standard of care dosing
cpic.implication: Higher dose-adjusted trough concentrations of voriconazole compared with normal metabolizers

note.en: Subtherapeutic concentrations are possible → discuss concentration monitoring (TDM).
note.ru: Возможны субтерапевтические концентрации → обсудить контроль концентрации (TDM).

cpic.recommendation: Choose an alternative agent that is not dependent on CYP2C19 metabolism as primary therapy in lieu of voriconazole. Such agents include liposomal amphotericin B and posaconazole.
cpic.implication: In patients for whom an ultrarapid metabolizer genotype (*17/*17) is identified, the probability of attainment of therapeutic concentrations is small

note.en: Reduced concentrations are possible → consider TDM.
note.ru: Возможны сниженные концентрации → рассмотреть TDM.

cpic.recommendation: Choose an alternative agent that is not dependent on CYP2C19 metabolism as primary therapy in lieu of voriconazole. Such agents include isavuconazole, liposomal amphotericin B, and posaconazole.
cpic.implication: In patients for whom a rapid metabolizer genotype (*1/*17) is identified, the probability of attainment of therapeutic concentrations is modest with standard dosing

note.en: Increased concentrations → a risk of toxicity, discuss the dose/TDM.
note.ru: Повышенные концентрации → риск токсичности, обсудить дозу/TDM.

cpic.recommendation: Choose an alternative agent that is not dependent on CYP2C19 metabolism as primary therapy in lieu of voriconazole. Such agents include liposomal amphotericin B and posaconazole. In the event that voriconazole is considered to be the most appropriate agent, based on clinical advice, for a patient with poor metabolizer genotype, voriconazole should be administered at a preferably lower than standard dosage with careful therapeutic drug monitoring.
cpic.implication: Higher dose-adjusted trough concentrations of voriconazole and may increase probability of adverse events

note.en: No features have been found by the markers.
note.ru: Особенностей по маркерам не выявлено.

why.en: VKORC1 is the target of warfarin; sensitivity affects the starting dose.
why.ru: VKORC1 — мишень варфарина; чувствительность влияет на стартовую дозу.

note.en: Normal VKORC1 sensitivity — no genetic reason to shift the starting dose. The dose itself comes from a validated algorithm that also needs CYP2C9, and from INR monitoring.
note.ru: Нормальная чувствительность VKORC1 — генетических причин смещать стартовую дозу нет. Сама доза считается по валидированному алгоритму, которому нужен ещё CYP2C9, и по контролю МНО.

note.en: High sensitivity → a lower starting dose is needed. The dosing algorithm also requires CYP2C9. Discuss it with the doctor + INR monitoring.
note.ru: Высокая чувствительность → нужна меньшая стартовая доза. Для алгоритма дозирования нужен также CYP2C9. Обсудить с врачом + контроль МНО.

note.en: Intermediate sensitivity. Calculating the dose also requires CYP2C9 (WGS). Discuss algorithm-based dosing + INR monitoring.
note.ru: Промежуточная чувствительность. Для расчёта дозы нужен также CYP2C9 (WGS). Обсудить дозирование по алгоритму + контроль МНО.

note.en: Warfarin dosing also requires CYP2C9 and INR monitoring.
note.ru: Дозирование варфарина требует также CYP2C9 и контроля МНО.

guidance_gap_reason.en: CPIC publishes warfarin dosing as an algorithm over CYP2C9, VKORC1 and CYP4F2 plus clinical factors, not as a sentence per phenotype, so no row here carries a verbatim quote.
guidance_gap_reason.ru: CPIC публикует дозирование варфарина как алгоритм по CYP2C9, VKORC1 и CYP4F2 плюс клинические факторы, а не как фразу на каждый фенотип, поэтому ни одна строка здесь не несёт дословной цитаты.

why.en: TPMT and NUDT15 both metabolise thiopurines; low activity in EITHER raises the risk of myelotoxicity. CPIC dosing follows the more severe of the two.
why.ru: TPMT и NUDT15 оба метаболизируют тиопурины; низкая активность ЛЮБОГО повышает риск миелотоксичности. Доза по CPIC — по более тяжёлому из двух.

note.en: Low TPMT activity → a high risk of myelotoxicity; discuss with the doctor a substantial dose reduction/an alternative.
note.ru: Низкая активность TPMT → высокий риск миелотоксичности; обсудить с врачом существенное снижение дозы/альтернативу.

cpic.recommendation: Consider alternative nonthiopurine immunosuppressant therapy.
cpic.implication: TPMT PMs have extremely high erythrocyte concentrations of TGN metabolites and no MeMPN compared to TPMT NMs.

note.en: Intermediate activity → discuss with the doctor a reduction of the starting dose and monitoring of the complete blood count.
note.ru: Промежуточная активность → обсудить с врачом снижение стартовой дозы и контроль ОАК.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with reduced starting doses (30-80% of standard starting dose) if standard starting dose is ≥2 mg/kg/day. If starting dose is already below standard starting dose, dose reduction might not be necessary. During therapy, adjust the doses of azathioprine based on the degree of myelosuppression and disease-specific guidelines. It usually takes at least 2-4 weeks of stable dosing to reach steady state after each dose adjustment.
cpic.implication: TPMT IMs have moderate to high erythrocyte concentrations of TGN metabolites and low concentrations of MeMPNs compared to TPMT NMs.

note.en: Normal by this marker; for completeness it is desirable to assess *3A/*3C and/or the enzyme activity.
note.ru: По маркеру норма; для полноты желательно оценить *3A/*3C и/или активность фермента.

cpic.recommendation: Initiate therapy with standard starting dose (e.g., 2 mg/kg/day for autoimmune diseases). During therapy, adjust doses of azathioprine based on disease-specific guidelines. It usually takes at least 2 weeks to reach steady state after each dose adjustment.
cpic.implication: TPMT NMs have lower erythrocyte concentrations of TGN metabolites and higher concentrations of MeMPNs compared to TPMT IMs and TPMT PMs. This is the 'normal' pattern.

note.en: Assess the TPMT status before prescribing.
note.ru: Оценить TPMT-статус перед назначением.

why.en: SLCO1B1 (rs4149056) affects statin transport; decreased function → a higher risk of myopathy (especially simvastatin).
why.ru: SLCO1B1 (rs4149056) влияет на транспорт статинов; сниженная функция → выше риск миопатии (особенно симвастатин).

note.en: Low SLCO1B1 function → a high risk of statin myopathy. Discuss with the doctor the choice of statin (not simvastatin at a high dose), a reduced dose and monitoring of CK/symptoms.
note.ru: Низкая функция SLCO1B1 → высокий риск статин-миопатии. Обсудить с врачом выбор статина (не симвастатин в высокой дозе), сниженную дозу и контроль КФК/симптомов.

cpic.recommendation: Prescribe an alternative statin depending on the desired potency (see Figure 1 of PMID: 35152405 for recommendations for alternative statins).
cpic.implication: Increased simvastatin acid exposure compared to normal and decreased function; highly increased myopathy risk

note.en: Intermediate SLCO1B1 function → a moderately increased risk of myopathy; take this into account when choosing the dose, especially of simvastatin.
note.ru: Промежуточная функция SLCO1B1 → умеренно повышенный риск миопатии; учитывать при выборе дозы, особенно симвастатина.

cpic.recommendation: Prescribe an alternative statin depending on the desired potency (see Figure 1 of PMID: 35152405 for recommendations for alternative statins). If simvastatin therapy is warranted, limit dose to <20mg/day.
cpic.implication: Increased simvastatin acid exposure as compared to normal function; increased risk of myopathy

note.en: There are no features by SLCO1B1; the standard approach.
note.ru: По SLCO1B1 особенностей нет; стандартный подход.

cpic.recommendation: Prescribe desired starting dose and adjust doses based on disease-specific guidelines.
cpic.implication: Typical myopathy risk and statin exposure

note.en: The SLCO1B1 genotype is unknown — an additional test is needed (WGS). Where dyslipidaemia and statin therapy apply, this marker is a priority to obtain.
note.ru: Генотип SLCO1B1 неизвестен — нужен доп. анализ (WGS). Если применимы дислипидемия и статинотерапия, этот маркёр — в приоритете.

note.en: The SLCO1B1 genotype (rs4149056) is needed.
note.ru: Нужен генотип SLCO1B1 (rs4149056).

why.en: CYP2D6 activates codeine/tramadol into active metabolites; the phenotype determines efficacy and risk.
why.ru: CYP2D6 активирует кодеин/трамадол в активные метаболиты; фенотип определяет эффективность и риск.

note.en: An ultrarapid metaboliser turns codeine into morphine faster — a risk of serious toxicity even at an ordinary dose. Discuss another pain medicine with the doctor.
note.ru: Сверхбыстрый метаболизатор превращает кодеин в морфин быстрее — риск серьёзной токсичности даже на обычной дозе. Обсудите с врачом другое обезболивающее.

cpic.recommendation: Avoid codeine use because of potential for serious toxicity. If opioid use is warranted, consider a non-tramadol opioid.
cpic.implication: Increased formation of morphine leading to higher risk of toxicity

note.en: A poor metaboliser forms almost no morphine from codeine — the pain relief may simply not arrive. Discuss another pain medicine with the doctor.
note.ru: Медленный метаболизатор почти не образует морфин из кодеина — обезболивания может просто не быть. Обсудите с врачом другое обезболивающее.

cpic.recommendation: Avoid codeine use because of possibility of diminished analgesia. If opioid use is warranted, consider a non-tramadol opioid.
cpic.implication: Greatly reduced morphine formation leading to diminished analgesia.

note.en: An intermediate metaboliser forms less morphine; the label dose is the starting point, and if it does not work the choice is worth discussing.
note.ru: Промежуточный метаболизатор образует меньше морфина; доза по инструкции — отправная точка, и если она не работает, выбор стоит обсудить.

cpic.recommendation: Use codeine label recommended age- or weight-specific dosing. If no response and opioid use is warranted, consider a non-tramadol opioid.
cpic.implication: Reduced morphine formation

note.en: A normal metaboliser — codeine is converted as expected; the usual dosing applies.
note.ru: Нормальный метаболизатор — кодеин превращается как ожидается; действует обычное дозирование.

note.en: The full CYP2D6 diplotype is unknown (WGS + PyPGx are needed). Until then the assessment is incomplete.
note.ru: Полный диплотип CYP2D6 неизвестен (нужен WGS + PyPGx). До этого оценка неполная.

note.en: The full CYP2D6 diplotype is needed.
note.ru: Нужен полный CYP2D6-диплотип.

why.en: DPYD breaks fluoropyrimidines down; a deficiency → severe toxicity.
why.ru: DPYD расщепляет фторпиримидины; дефицит → тяжёлая токсичность.

note.en: A DPYD loss-of-function variant has been found → a high risk of severe fluoropyrimidine toxicity. Before prescribing, discuss with the oncologist a substantial dose reduction/an alternative.
note.ru: Найден вариант потери функции DPYD → высокий риск тяжёлой токсичности фторпиримидинов. Перед назначением обсудить с онкологом существенное снижение дозы/альтернативу.

cpic.recommendation: Avoid use of 5-fluorouracil or 5-fluorouracil prodrug-based regimens. In the event, based on clinical advice, alternative agents are not considered a suitable therapeutic option, 5-fluorouracil should be administered at a strongly reduced dose with early therapeutic drug monitoring.
cpic.implication: Complete DPD deficiency and increased risk for severe or even fatal drug toxicity when treated with fluoropyrimidine drugs.

note.en: Intermediate DPD activity → an increased risk of toxicity; discuss with the oncologist a reduction of the starting dose.
note.ru: Промежуточная активность DPD → повышенный риск токсичности; обсудить с онкологом снижение стартовой дозы.

cpic.recommendation: Reduce starting dose by 50% followed by titration of dose based on toxicity or therapeutic drug monitoring (if available).
cpic.implication: Decreased DPD activity (leukocyte DPD activity at 30% to 70% that of the normal population) and increased risk for severe or even fatal drug toxicity when treated with fluoropyrimidine drugs

note.en: Normal by the DPYD markers examined (this does not fully exclude a deficiency; rare variants are outside the panel).
note.ru: По исследованным маркерам DPYD — норма (полностью дефицит не исключает; редкие варианты вне панели).

cpic.recommendation: Based on genotype, there is no indication to change dose or therapy. Use label-recommended dosage and administration.
cpic.implication: Normal DPD activity and "normal" risk for fluoropyrimidine toxicity

note.en: The DPYD status is unknown (WGS is needed). Before any fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy DPYD is mandatory — flag it for the oncologist.
note.ru: DPYD-статус неизвестен (нужен WGS). Перед любой фторпиримидиновой химиотерапией DPYD обязателен — отметить для онколога.

note.en: The DPYD genotype is needed.
note.ru: Нужен генотип DPYD.

note.en: CPIC publishes no methotrexate pharmacogenetic guideline, and ACMG recommends AGAINST clinical testing of MTHFR C677T/A1298C for drug dosing. There is no pharmacogenetic dosing signal to report for this drug; MTHFR is folate-context only.
note.ru: У CPIC нет фармакогенетического гайдлайна по метотрексату, а ACMG рекомендует ПРОТИВ клинического тестирования MTHFR C677T/A1298C для дозирования. Фармакогенетического сигнала для дозирования этого препарата нет; MTHFR — только контекст фолатов.
